payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies session_22323920c486 as the root blocker: it executed the same inventory UPDATE and is idle in transaction holding an uncommitted row lock, blocking the business request session_240651e5417e; no other blockers exist upstream. The state report confirms session_22323920c486 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the decrement can complete; other causes (large data, redundant index, vacuum) are ruled out by the diagnostic report.
